what_it_is: Flow Re-Direction Endoluminal Device (FRED) with X Technology, a proprietary nanoscale surface treatment covalently bonded to the device surface. The X Technology coating creates an optimized protective hydration layer that reduces material thrombogenicity while maintaining the natural vessel healing response (comparable endothelial cell growth to bare device in-vitro). Offers the same precise, predictable placement and immediate opening of the original FRED device, with reduced delivery and retraction forces for easier tracking through tortuous anatomies.
sizing_specs: Implant diameter range: 2.5, 3.0, 3.5, 4.0, 4.5, 5.0, 5.5 mm. Working lengths per diameter: 2.5 mm (13, 18, 25, 30 mm), 3.0 mm (13, 19, 27, 32 mm), 3.5 mm (13, 17, 22, 31, 40 mm), 4.0 mm (13, 18, 23, 32, 44 mm), 4.5 mm (15, 20, 25, 34, 45 mm), 5.0 mm (15, 21, 26, 36 mm), 5.5 mm (22, 32 mm). Total 28 SKUs. FRED X 2.5 and 3.0 mm sizes have no distal lead wire.
indications: USA (PMA P180027): Indicated for use in the internal carotid artery from the petrous segment to the terminus for endovascular treatment of adult patients (≥22 years old) with wide-necked (neck width ≥4 mm or dome-to-neck ratio <2) saccular or fusiform intracranial aneurysms arising from a parent vessel 2.0-5.0 mm in diameter. Canada: indicated for intracranial aneurysms not amenable to surgical clipping with parent vessels 2.0-5.0 mm. EMEA/CHAPLA: endovascular embolization of intracranial neurovascular aneurysms, with or without embolic coils.
compatible_with: FRED X 2.5-3.0 mm devices: 0.021" Headway 21 Microcatheter. FRED X 3.5-5.5 mm devices: 0.027" Headway 27 Microcatheter. SOFIA family intermediate catheters for tri-axial support. Chaperon guiding catheters, Traxcess guidewires.
use_notes: Dual-layer braid design (inherited from original FRED). X Technology surface modification reduces thrombus formation in in-vitro testing compared to bare flow diverter. FRED X 2.5-3.0 mm small-vessel variants optimized for distal flow diversion with no distal lead wire. [FDA RECALL history] 2 recalls: tantalum length/attachment pattern manufacturing issue (may lead to incomplete opening or malapposition); incorrect inner stent length. (MicroVention is now Terumo Neuro.)
also_known_as: Flow Re-Direction Endoluminal Device with X Technology
